claims: Stiffness, A-stability, Dahlquist barriers and BDF theory
BDF and Radau implicit methods for stiff problems

checks: Model y1'=-1000 y1 + y2, y2'=-y2: eigenvalues -1000 and -1, stiffness ratio S = 1000
Stability functions: Euler 1+z; backward Euler 1/(1-z); trapezoid (1+z/2)(1-z/2)^{-1}
BDF1 and BDF2 are A-stable; BDF3-BDF6 are only A(alpha)-stable (alpha decreasing with order)
